because: Counterexample (hunt 2026-10-10, confirmed with strace): records written by a handle that died before syncing were reopened with unsynced=0, so the next sync skipped fsync and offered them as the durable head. Fix: records found on open count as unsynced until the first sync.
statement: Only a fsynced head is offered. A peer adds at most one witness record per WITNESS_MIN_INTERVAL to this log, and a head that is not 64 lowercase hex is not recorded; both refusals are counted.
